meta.description: Minimal object-level axiom scaffolds and closure assumptions.

axioms.name: Existence via Continuation
axioms.statement: An object exists only if it has an admissible continuation in at least one orientation frame.

axioms.name: Residue Persistence
axioms.statement: Every continuation event generates or updates a residue state.

heuristics.name: Orientation Minimalization
heuristics.statement: Processes prefer orientation frames that minimize local residue pressure.
